name: EVERITA Capital
decision_note: Prague-based SME growth private equity fund taking majority stakes (Pekarna Hrstić 51%, Mar 2026; CLINTRIAL majority, Aug 2026); real and active but not VC, so outside the cz-vc pilot.

evidence.quote: EVERITA Capital partners with resourceful founders of SMEs in sectors experiencing structural growth.
EVERITA Capital, a private equity investment fund focused on investing in small and medium-sized companies in Central Europe, has chosen Croatia for its first investment.
a majority stake in CLINTRIAL s.r.o., an established Prague-based provider of clinical trial services.
uzavřela v těchto dnech svůj první fond Everita Fund I a cílí na palebnou sílu 40 milionů eur, tedy zhruba na miliardu korun.
EVERITA Capital is pleased to announce that the European Investment Fund (“EIF”) Board of Directors has approved a EUR 20 million investment in EVERITA Fund.

analyst_notes: Quick S1 dossier. EVERITA is the successor of ESPIRA Investments (same partner Emília Mamajová, same registered address Na Florenci 2116/15; the EIF release says EVERITA Fund 'will continue the established investment strategy of ESPIRA Investments'). Fund I: the 2025-10-12 article (reprinted on EVERITA's site; header indicates Hospodářské noviny) says the fund was closed and targets EUR 40m firepower; recorded as a 'target' of EUR 40m and used as capital (latest_fund_size), not a confirmed final close. EIF approved a EUR 20m commitment (2024-12-27); RSJ and a J&T fund are named as LPs in the article headline. Sectors from the homepage list (healthcare, education, specialty manufacturing, consumer goods, business services) mapped to the closed list. Ticket EUR 2-5m only from the self-reported CVCA profile (class D; the profile already mentions Clintrial and Pekarna Hrstić, so it was edited after its 2020 publication date). Fund vehicle not found in ARES.
